name: Shojo-gari ~Lolita Shoujo no Gokkan Shigai-chi~
original_name: 処女狩り～ロリータ少女の極姦市街地～
source:
Frantically defend yourself from an onslaught of young girl hordes! 
Target lolita character icons by clicking on them as they appear. 

An adventure game with MAP system and click-barrage gameplay. 

Will you successfully beat down the waves, or fall victim to their march of cuteness? It's up to you!

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE063884.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
疯狂地保护自己免受年轻女孩群体的攻击！
通过点击出现的洛丽塔角色图标来定位它们。

一款带有地图系统和点击弹幕玩法的冒险游戏。

你会成功击退海浪，还是成为可爱行进的受害者？由你决定！

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE063884.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
